children: AtlasClear Holdings said preliminary unaudited results for fiscal 2026 showed total revenues of approximately $20.1 million (up ~85% year-over-year) and interest income of roughly $1.8 million, bringing revenues plus interest to about $21.9 million. The company reported expected net income of approximately $2.0 million and cash and cash equivalents of about $15.4 million at June 30, 2026. Management noted material growth across commission and newer non-commission lines and said results are preliminary and subject to audit.
Total revenues (preliminary, fiscal 2026): approximately $20.1 million (approximately 85% increase from $10.9 million in fiscal 2025).

Interest income (presented in other income): approximately $1.8 million; total revenues plus interest income: approximately $21.9 million (approximately 70% increase from $12.9 million in fiscal 2025).
Net income (preliminary, fiscal 2026): approximately $2.0 million, marking a second consecutive year of positive net income.

Balance sheet snapshots at June 30, 2026 (preliminary): cash and cash equivalents of approximately $15.4 million and total stockholders’ equity of approximately $21.1 million (versus a deficit of ~$6.8 million at June 30, 2025).
Stock locate fees launched and scaled in fiscal 2026, rising to approximately $6.8 million from about $0.3 million and representing ~34% of total revenues.
Non-commission revenue lines now represent approximately 54% of total revenues, up from 45% in fiscal 2025, reflecting diversification beyond core commissions.
Net gains on firm trading accounts contributed approximately $0.5 million in fiscal 2026.

AtlasClearing increased net capital to approximately $14.4 million at June 30, 2026 (about $14.1 million above its minimum requirement), supporting clearing activities and correspondent relationships.

Signed clearing agreements with six new correspondent broker-dealers currently in onboarding and conversion; revenue from these relationships was not meaningful in fiscal 2026 and is expected to contribute in fiscal 2027.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: AtlasClear Holdings Reports FY2026 Revenue ~$20.1M, Net Income ~$2.0M
